about.title: Diab Car, car rental agency in Casablanca
about.intro: Diab Car is a self-drive car rental agency founded in Casablanca in {year}. Based on Boulevard Zerktouni, the agency delivers its vehicles across the city and at Mohammed V Airport.

story.title: A neighbourhood agency with international standards
story.p1: We built Diab Car around a simple conviction: in Morocco, car rental suffers less from a lack of cars than from a lack of clarity. Prices quoted without insurance, cash deposits, excesses discovered on the day of a claim.
story.p2: Our answer: a recent, regularly renewed fleet, all-inclusive prices in dirhams, a deposit by bank pre-authorisation and one contact reachable on WhatsApp in four languages. For us, luxury is the absence of bad surprises.
story.p3: Today we serve Moroccan families returning home for the summer, business travellers from Casablanca Finance City, tourists from Spain and the Gulf, and companies that would rather rent monthly than tie up capital.

blog.intro: Practical advice, verified figures and direct answers for driving with peace of mind in Casablanca and beyond.
blog.ctaText: Recent cars delivered at Mohammed V Airport, all-inclusive prices in dirhams.

1.title: 1. Purpose
1.text: These terms govern the self-drive rental of vehicles by {legalName} (“Diab Car”) to the renter named in the contract. An online booking is a request; the rental is concluded when the contract is signed and the keys handed over.

2.title: 2. Driver requirements
2.text: The driver must be at least 21 years old (25 for the premium category, 28 for the luxury category), hold a driving licence valid for more than one year and present an ID document. Licences in a non-Latin script must be accompanied by an International Driving Permit. Any additional driver must be declared in the contract.

3.title: 3. Prices and payment
3.text: Prices are in Moroccan dirhams, all taxes included, and cover third-party liability, theft and damage insurance, the mileage indicated on the vehicle page and delivery in Casablanca and at Mohammed V Airport. Payment is made at pick-up by bank card, cash or bank transfer (long term).

4.title: 4. Deposit
4.text: A deposit, whose amount appears on the vehicle page and in the contract, is taken as a pre-authorisation on the main driver’s bank card. It is not charged and is released within 7 working days after the vehicle is returned without damage, fines or missing fuel.

5.title: 5. Insurance and excess
5.text: In the event of at-fault damage or damage without an identified third party, the renter’s liability is limited to the excess, equal to the deposit, unless the zero-excess option was taken. In all cases the renter remains liable for: tyres, glass, underbody, keys, fuel, interior, and any damage resulting from drunk driving, off-road use or an undeclared driver.

6.title: 6. Use of the vehicle
6.text: The vehicle may not leave Moroccan territory. Prohibited: subletting, paid transport of people or goods, competitions, towing and driving on unpaved tracks. Fines and offences recorded during the rental are borne by the renter, plus a MAD 150 handling fee.

7.title: 7. Fuel and mileage
7.text: The vehicle is handed over with a full tank and must be returned full; missing fuel is charged at the day’s price plus a MAD 100 service fee. Kilometres beyond the stated allowance are charged at MAD 2–4 depending on the category.

8.title: 8. Cancellation and changes
8.text: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the pick-up time. Later, or in case of no-show, one rental day may be charged. Changes of dates or vehicle are subject to availability.

9.title: 9. Return
9.text: The vehicle must be returned at the agreed place, date and time. A delay of more than one hour results in an additional day being charged. A joint inspection, supported by photos, is carried out at departure and return.

10.title: 10. Personal data and disputes
10.text: Data collected is processed in accordance with Law 09-08 and our privacy policy. These terms are governed by Moroccan law; any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the competent courts of Casablanca.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Diab Car collects the minimum data needed to process your booking and complies with Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.

1.title: Data collected
1.text: Name, phone, email, country of residence, driver’s age, flight number and booking details. At rental: a copy of the licence and ID document, as required by regulation.

2.title: Purposes
2.text: Process and confirm your request, draw up the rental contract, contact you if needed during the rental, meet our legal and accounting obligations, improve our service.

3.title: Legal basis and retention
3.text: Performance of the contract and legal obligations. Booking data is kept for 5 years in line with accounting obligations, then deleted or anonymised.

4.title: Recipients
4.text: Diab Car only, plus its technical processors (Vercel hosting, Supabase database, Resend emails) and, in the event of a claim, our insurance company.

5.title: Cookies
5.text: The site uses a language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE), a theme cookie and, if you accept, Google Analytics 4 to measure audience in aggregate. No targeted advertising.

6.title: Your rights
6.text: You have the right to access, rectify, object to and delete your data. Write to us at {email}. You may also contact the CNDP (Morocco’s national data protection authority).
